Review commits 0301ac4a8 and d3975601f: versioned envelope mint/propagate, signal-boundary integration, no-field-loss and causal-chain tests. Verification: 42 passed, 4 skipped.

Reviewed commits 0301ac4a8/d3975601f: changes requested. The envelope
contract library and signal-boundary mint are solid (19+23 tests pass),
but propagation stops there -- it never reaches risk_policy.py,
executor.py's signal-context allow-list, broker/sinopac/adapter.py,
paper_runtime.py's telemetry emitter, or reconciliation-drift, so the
task's own "signal to broker/ledger/reconciliation, no manual join"
acceptance bar is unmet. Findings, file:line pointers, and required
changes recorded in docs/reviews/2026-07-12-tj-e2e-003-claude-review.md
(PR #3312, auto-merging into dev).

Re-review requested after merged PR #3312 (merge 381d1af6f72d0a6ffea4e854e04d679d87565cbf): executor, risk, Shioaji broker, paper telemetry, and reconciliation drift now propagate the envelope; 119 focused tests and 50 boundary tests passed.

Round 2 review: all 5 producer boundaries now genuinely propagate the envelope (verified manually for the 2 untested ones). See docs/reviews/2026-07-12-tj-e2e-003-claude-review-round2.md.
Round 2 required regression coverage added in bd21f62b0: executor _signal_context_metadata and paper RuntimeTelemetryEmitter.build_event correlation-envelope propagation; focused suite 53 passed.

Round 2 review: executor/risk/paper-telemetry/reconciliation-drift propagation verified as real wired call chains, accepted. Required changes 1-4 recorded in docs/reviews/2026-07-12-tj-e2e-003-claude-review.md.

Round 2 broker-boundary gap fixed in 251defd29: signal-driven Taiwan paper runtime now posts signal-derived client_order_id plus correlation_envelope; broker sidecar propagates broker.paper_sidecar causal hop and persists both; submit/store/reload proof added; delivered contract distinguishes manual Shioaji sandbox facade. Verification: 132 passed focused suite. Please perform round 3 review.

All four round-2 required changes verified with submit->store->readback proof (services/broker/test_paper_correlation.py, services/execution/lean_runtime/test_paper_runtime.py).
